shape_normalization.density: subtract first traced density and divide by traced density span
shape_normalization.exposure: map the 10 percent and 90 percent normalized-density crossings to 0 and 1
shape_normalization.pair_domain: intersection of both traced normalized-exposure domains and the frozen comparison grid

comparison.direct_source_domain_diagnostic: piecewise-linear density RMSE over the common traced log-relative-exposure domain; reported but not used for diversity promotion because graph gauges and unstated densitometric status remain nuisance variables

allowed_actions: Verify exact first-party PDF and embedded graph identities.
Audit the frozen solid-curve traces and generate source overlays.
Measure direct and affine-gauge-normalized source-curve diversity.
Retain a research-only source-domain bank only if frozen diversity gates pass.
forbidden_actions: Do not interpret curve differences as calibrated stock response or digital RGB mapping.
Do not use photograph pixels, AO6 outputs or P2R failures to tune traces or gates.
Do not change thresholds after formal execution or rescue one channel with a larger model.
Do not map B/G/R layer labels directly onto an ordinary image RGB tensor.
Do not open product integration, photographic evaluation or latent modes from this source audit.
claim_ceiling: First-party manufacturer-graph source-domain characteristic-shape diversity diagnostic for VISION3 50D/250D/500T; not calibrated stock response, particular-roll evidence, digital-to-film identification or a product operator.
